---
title: "Repository and website editing"
subtitle: "Folder structure, static page editing, and automatically generated files"
---

The GitHub repository contains the source files, configuration, and automated scripts for the RC42 website.

* **Repository address:** `https://github.com/isa-rc42/ISA42`
* **Primary branch (`main`):** Changes committed to the `main` branch automatically trigger a site build and deployment.

```
ISA42 (Repository root)
├── .github/workflows/     Automated workflow definitions (GitHub Actions)
├── data/                  Data files used by the website (managed automatically)
├── feeds/                 Public RSS feed for community contributions
├── scripts/               Python scripts for data processing and validation
├── about/                 Static pages: About RC42, History, Statutes
├── admin/                 This Administration Guide
├── congress/              Static pages: ISA Congress sessions and announcements
├── contact/               Contact page and submission links
├── members/               Members Directory page
├── news/                  News, events, and community contribution pages
├── newsletter/            Newsletter archive and privacy policy
├── people/                Board members and past boards directory
├── resources/             Academic resources directory
├── _quarto.yml            Main website configuration (menus, footer, title)
└── styles.scss            Design stylesheet (typography, colors, layout)
```

## Editing static institutional pages

Unlike directory pages (which update from Google Sheets), static institutional pages—such as About RC42, Statutes, or Board Member listings—are edited directly in Quarto source files (`.qmd`):

1. Edit the relevant `.qmd` file in the repository.
2. Commit the changes to the `main` branch.
3. The `Publish to GitHub Pages` workflow triggers automatically.
4. Quarto compiles the updated pages and deploys them online within 90 seconds.

### Source files for common site updates

| Section to update | File path |
|:---|:---|
| Navigation menus, footer, site title | `_quarto.yml` |
| Colors, fonts, CSS styles | `styles.scss` |
| About RC42, History, Statutes | `about/index.qmd` |
| Current Executive Board members | `people/index.qmd` |
| Past Executive Boards archive | `people/past-boards/index.qmd` |
| ISA Congress sessions and news | `congress/index.qmd` |
| Contact page information | `contact/index.qmd` |

### Recommended editing tools

* **GitHub web editor:** Suitable for minor text adjustments. Open the file on GitHub and select the edit icon.
* **Positron IDE:** An open-source desktop editor developed for Quarto and scientific publishing, offering integrated live preview.
* **Visual Studio Code:** Standard text editor with the official Quarto extension.

## Automatically generated files

::: {.callout-warning}
## Do not edit generated data files manually

The following files are generated and overwritten automatically by synchronization scripts. Direct edits to these files will be erased on the next scheduled update:
:::

| File path | Generated by | Manage content in |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `data/community_submissions.json` | Community sync workflow | `ISA RC42 Community Submissions` Google Sheet |
| `data/community_submissions.yml` | Community sync workflow | `ISA RC42 Community Submissions` Google Sheet |
| `feeds/community-contributions.xml` | Community sync workflow | `ISA RC42 Community Submissions` Google Sheet |
| `data/members.json` | Members sync workflow | `Active Members RC42 Social Psychology` Google Sheet |
| `data/past_members.json` | Members sync workflow | `Active Members RC42 Social Psychology` Google Sheet |
| `data/resources.json` | Resources sync workflow | `rc42_resources_workflow` Google Sheet |
| `data/community_resources.json` | Resources sync workflow | `ISA RC42 Community Submissions` Google Sheet |
